note: Reproducibility matrix for the 2026-11-05 sampling-seed round. Six rounds: three scene inits (3, 4, 5 -- the same init indices the formal three-step batches used, so the scene side is already characterised) crossed with two policy seeds (101, 202). Every round carries the SAME instruction, the explicit ordered three-step request from the frozen base suite, so the action stream is the only variable: routing is not re-measured here, and a difference between two rounds with the same init and the same policy_seed cannot be blamed on the model's wording. The instruction is English because zh_explicit_three_steps is an open routing miss in the frozen suite (it answers with the flow id); using it would smuggle a routing difference into a sampling comparison. Each round is run once, in this order; no retry, no skip, and a failed round stays in the denominator. These six rounds are a diagnostic baseline, not a success-rate claim: a fixed seed makes two runs comparable, it does not make them succeed.
